claims: Bill Self is the Kansas basketball coach.
Bill Self has dealt with consistent heart issues over the past few years, including atrial fibrillation (AFib) and blocked arteries.
Bill Self had four stents inserted since 2023.
Bill Self had two stents inserted in 2023.
Chest tightness and balance concerns forced Bill Self to miss the Big 12 and NCAA tournaments.
Bill Self was hospitalized in July 2024 and later had two more stents inserted.
Bill Self was hospitalized briefly in January 2026 for dehydration and AFib.
As of March 2026, Bill Self noted he was feeling "as good as I've felt in a long time."
Bill Self stopped the consumption of red meat, fast food, yellow cheese, and sweets following his 2025 procedures.
